title: Concept: Client-side or header redirect to computed address (php) — review required
description: In php, headers*(s*['"]Location: navigates to a computed address. Client-side and header redirects are as abusable as server-side ones when input shapes the target. The remedy is target validation via a same-origin check.
applicability: php code assigning redirect targets; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Phishing via trusted-domain links; MEDIUM severity.
